## Checked

- [ ] I ran the tests that touch what I changed (`node lamplighter/tests/<name>.test.js`), and added one for any new behaviour.
- [ ] No network call, tracker, cookie, or font or script from another site (`privacy.test.js`).
- [ ] Neutral: no verdict on a living community or person in the tool's own voice; claims labelled documented, reported or claimed, or disputed.
- [ ] A fact I added names its source; a text I added is public domain or openly licensed and keeps its printed pages.
- [ ] I did not change a storage name (`beatlab.v1.`, `beatlab-own`, `BEATLAB_*`, …).
